purpose: Field guide for dcc_skills.json and dcc_spells.json

entry_fields.name: Display name.
entry_fields.flavor_text: Italic flavor text directly attached to the entry.
entry_fields.tags_raw: Source metadata line preserved as text.
entry_fields.stat: Primary listed Stat, normalized to full name when present.
entry_fields.area_of_effect: True if tagged Area of Effect.
entry_fields.attack_mode: melee/ranged for weapon attack skills when listed.
entry_fields.damage_effect_for: Parent attack skill(s) for a Damage Effect skill.
entry_fields.damage_types: Damage/effect types parsed from tags/base damage.
entry_fields.description: Main rules/body text, with paragraph breaks.
entry_fields.upgrades_note: Used when the source says there are no upgrades.
entry_fields.raw_text: Normalized entry text retained as a fallback/reference.
entry_fields.source: PDF and printed-page ranges for traceability.
